fields.description: What this society calls this piece of work, such as Flood Response or Branch First Aid Duty.
fields.label: Title of Mission

fields.description: The stable key deployments and requests point at. Renaming the terms later does not change what happened under them.
fields.label: Key

fields.description: The programme of work these terms are written under — ERPNext's own Project, the same record the society's costs, timesheets and project dashboard hang off. Required before these terms can be submitted.
fields.label: Project

fields.description: Whether these terms are still offered for new work. Untick to retire them; deployments already run under them stay intact.
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: When the mission is expected to begin. Offered as a default; each deployment's own dates govern. Leave empty for standing work.
fields.label: Expected Start Date

fields.description: When the mission is expected to end. Must not fall before the expected start date.
fields.label: Expected End Date

fields.description: How many days a deployment under these terms usually runs. Offered as a default. Zero means there is no usual length.
fields.label: Usual Duration (Days)

fields.description: The part of the organisation these terms may be used in — that branch and everything under it. Terms written for the whole society name the national node; naming nothing is not an option, because a mission document that applies nowhere in particular cannot be routed for approval and cannot be told apart from one somebody had not finished.
fields.label: Geo Scope

fields.description: What a deployment under these terms is for, in one or two sentences. This is the line shown wherever the terms are listed.
fields.label: Purpose

fields.description: The situation this mission answers to: what happened, what is needed, what has been done already. Printed at the head of the terms.
fields.label: Mission Background

fields.description: Who this mission deals with, and how to reach them. Printed on the terms so a deployed volunteer carries the contacts.
fields.label: Stakeholders

fields.description: What this mission sets out to achieve, one per row. Numbered on the printed document in this order.
fields.label: Objectives

fields.description: What the mission will leave behind: a register updated, a community trained, a report filed.
fields.label: Expected Outputs

fields.description: How the work will be done, chosen from the society's methodologies, with a note on what each means here.
fields.label: Approach Methodology

fields.description: The plan by day: what happens, when, and who leads it. Dated rows must fall inside the mission's own period.
fields.label: Itinerary

fields.description: What the mission needs and what it is expected to cost. Each row's total is worked out from quantity and unit cost.
fields.label: Resources

fields.description: Tick where this mission genuinely needs nothing budgeted. Submission requires either resource lines or this, so that an empty table is always a deliberate answer rather than one somebody had not got to yet.
fields.label: This Mission Needs No Resources

fields.description: What a volunteer must hold to be a candidate. Mandatory rows filter; desirable rows only rank. Lapsed certifications drop out automatically.
fields.label: Required Certifications

fields.description: What a volunteer deployed under these terms is expected to do, in your own words.
fields.label: Responsibilities

fields.description: Whether a request to deploy under these terms needs authorising. Direct: whoever raises it fulfils it. Routed: it goes to an approver first, and needs an approval workflow.
fields.label: Approval Mode

fields.description: Anything about these terms that is not a field.
fields.label: Notes

fields.description: The terms these replace. Set when a mission has to be respecified after deployments have already been run under the original — the one case a cancel-and-amend cannot serve, because the deployments already agreed keep the wording they were agreed under. This is the thread back to it.
fields.label: Supersedes

fields.description: Where this document has got to in the society's own approval workflow, if it has configured one for terms of reference. Empty means it has not, and a user with submit permission may submit directly. Written by the approval engine only.
fields.label: Approval State
fields.options:
Draft
Submitted
In Review
Approved
Rejected
Withdrawn
Expired

fields.description: Every decision recorded against this document, in the order they were made.
fields.label: Approval Decisions

fields.description: The terms this document amends. Deployments already run under the original keep pointing at the original.
fields.label: Amended From
